articles.title: Colossal Spinout Astromech Acquires Sister Company Form Bio for $230M
articles.summary: Two Austin startups that spun out of Dallas-based de-extinction behemoth Colossal Biosciences are coming together to tackle challenges in designing genetic medicine. Astromech, an AI company developing models to predict changes in living systems, said today it acquired Form Bio, a business that creates models and tools for designing genetic medicines. …

articles.title: Dallas AI Startup 4Minds Raises $15M Series A at $500M Valuation
articles.summary: Dallas-based AI startup 4Minds, which emerged from stealth mode in April, is already halfway to unicorn status. The company said today that it has raised a $15 million Series A round at a $500 million post-money valuation. Investors include Dallas-based Waterwood Capital Group and Lubbock-based Isom Holdings — both led in part by Clayton Isom, whose family founded Wichita Falls-based oil and gas management company Stephens & Johnson in the 1960s — and several family offices with ties to the energy and data center industries. …

articles.title: Texas cities and counties forgo $1 billion in taxes to data centers in exchange for few job guarantees
articles.summary: The Tribune found 53 local tax agreements across 34 data centers guaranteed a total of 465 jobs. Roughly half of the agreements had no job stipulations.

articles.title: Texas regulators are resuming environmental permits for data centers
articles.summary: Gov. Greg Abbott, who lost his reelection, had ordered the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality to pause permit approvals related to data centers.

articles.title: Data Centers and Gambling Show How Power Works at the Texas Capitol
articles.summary: Heading into the 2027 legislative session, two issues are almost certain to get marquee billing at the Texas Capitol. One is the speculative rush of hyperscaler data center development all across the state. The other is gambling—what activity that covers, whether it should be legalized and to what extent. Both are polarizing issues with heavyweight […]
